**Nvidia had the higher gross margin in fiscal 2025, by about 6.2 percentage points.** I worked from the figures as I remember them from the 10-Ks, without searching to confirm them.

- **Nvidia** (fiscal year ended January 2025): gross profit of about $97.86B on revenue of about $130.50B gives a gross margin of about 74.99%.
- **Microsoft** (fiscal year ended June 2025): gross profit of about $193.89B on revenue of about $281.72B gives a gross margin of about 68.82%.

The difference is 74.99% − 68.82% ≈ 6.17 percentage points.
